messages:
maria: Heads-up — customer acme-inc is seeing duplicated completions right after a quota reset window. They say this started after their quota moved from 500r/s to 5kr/s in us-west and they hit a short 429 surge.
maria: They're on SDK v0.12 with default retry settings (maxRetries=5, expo backoff). Raw snippet and logs below — note the repeated user payload and two successful 200 responses ~150ms apart.
maria: ```
# client request
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
Idempotency-Key: (none)
payload: {"prompt":"summarize..."}

# response seq
429 Retry-After: 0.2
429 Retry-After: 0.4
200 X-Request-Id: r-abc123
200 X-Request-Id: r-abc123
``` 
ivan: OK. Two quick q's: 1) did they provide an Idempotency-Key for these calls? 2) are they using SDK concurrency (Promise.all) that may have retried the same call object? If no idempotency key, server cannot safely dedupe.
dev-support: They confirmed no Idempotency-Key. They are indeed firing bursts from a worker pool with concurrency=50 during warmup. Sounds like a classic in-flight-retry vs server-side quota race.
ivan: Repro strategy — can we get them to run a small harness with single-call idempotency token + full-jitter expo backoff to validate? Example suggested change (js sdk):

ivan: ```js
// recommend: small maxRetries, expo+full jitter, idempotency for non-idempotent ops
client.defaults = {
  maxRetries: 3,
  backoffBaseMs: 100,
  backoffMaxMs: 2000,
  jitter: 'full',
  idempotency: true
}
``` 
maria: I asked them to try that. Also recommended turning on token bucket smoothing on their side (limit ramp from 0->50 over 30s) to avoid thundering herd when quota increases.
sdk-bot: Note — server-side behavior: when quota resets, token refills can cause transient 429s; our autoscaler may briefly route to a colder pool. Best-effort dedupe requires Idempotency-Key or transactional semantics.
oncall-ops: If they still see duplicate 200s after adding idempotency tokens, collect X-Request-Id and full request bodies (redact PII). We can correlate and, if necessary, mark duplicates and offer refund.
ivan: A couple of quick guidance bullets we can send the customer now:
- Use an idempotency key for create/generate calls if retries are enabled.
- Prefer expo backoff with full jitter (base 100ms, cap 2s) and reduce maxRetries (3) to limit duplicate windows.
- Add client-side smoothing on quota increases (ramp concurrency)
- If you must use aggressive concurrency, add server-side idempotency middleware or dedupe logic.
maria: Customer tried the idempotency change and a lower retry count. They report no duplicates in initial 2k requests test. I'll keep the thread updated.
support-bot: Created ticket INC-4532 for follow-up and billing review in case duplicates caused overage.
dev-support: Nice. Let's capture this as a short KB: "Client-side smoothing + idempotency prevents duplicate completions during quota bursts" and include the recommended SDK snippet and config defaults.
maria: Adding one more note for KB: explain why linear backoff + low jitter can amplify collisions — full jitter spreads retries and reduces synchronized retry storms.
ivan: Agree. I'll draft the KB and ping docs so SDK defaults show expo+full-jitter recommended values in next patch.
maria: Thanks — closing loop once KB and customer confirm stable for 24h.
